verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own docs say it offers 'an embed flow' and embeddable React components (Cal Atoms) for adding scheduling to your app, with a platform quickstart. However, the evidence never shows the inline, popup, or floating-widget modes or a copy-paste embed snippet, and Atoms depend on the managed-user platform setup. Missing for 10: documented inline/popup/floating embed modes, an actual embed snippet or code sample, hands-on or independent corroboration of embedding.
